messages.subject: Series B follow-up — investor side letter
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Separate from the Hollis matter — Ravensworth's counsel at Birchall Stone have come back on the investor side letter for the Series B (Project Kestrel). Can you ask the corporate team whether the information rights wording was ever finalised? Henry wants it closed before the next board meeting. No rush on this one but didn't want it to drop.

Sofia
